# Serenitilabs — Full Company Reference

> Serenitilabs Sdn. Bhd. is an AI-native mental health provider in Malaysia: licensed clinical psychologists deliver psychotherapy and corporate wellness programmes, and its own AI companion, Damaura, supports people between sessions. This document is a complete, plain-text reference for AI assistants and search engines.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Serenitilabs Sdn. Bhd.
- SSM registration: 202601000377 (1662475-P)
- Accreditation: HRD Corp Registered Training Provider (Pembangunan Sumber Manusia Berhad), valid 4 August 2026 to 3 August 2027. Note: the certificate serial is the same number as the SSM registration.
- Founded: 5 January 2026
- Headquarters: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- Sector: Healthcare Technology / Mental Wellness
- Area served: Malaysia (services available online and in person)
- Languages: English, Bahasa Malaysia
- Email: hello@sereniti.my
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 18-398 1795
- Website: https://sereniti.my
- Tagline: Expert care. Intelligent support.

## Vision and mission

Vision: A world where seeking mental health support is as natural and accessible as seeing a doctor for a physical checkup.

Mission: To deliver expert-led mental health care, enhanced by AI, that empowers individuals and organisations to thrive, starting in Malaysia.

Approach: Serenitilabs pairs licensed human clinicians with Damaura, its AI companion. Technology extends the reach of therapists; it does not replace them. The AI makes the practice better; the people make it Serenitilabs.

Model: Serenitilabs is a full-stack, AI-native mental health provider. It does not sell AI to clinics or HR teams. It employs the clinicians, delivers therapy and corporate programmes itself, and builds its own AI. Registered clinical psychologists lead every session and make every clinical decision; AI does the work around the care. For organisations this means one partner for therapy, training (as an HRD Corp Registered Training Provider) and Damaura.

## Services

### Psychotherapy
Evidence-based therapy by licensed professionals, with specialised tracks for adults, children, couples, and families. Available online and in person.

### Corporate Wellness Programmes
End-to-end employee mental wellness: on-site and online therapy sessions, workshops and training, manager and leadership briefings, and Damaura access for continuous team support. Serenitilabs Sdn. Bhd. is an HRD Corp Registered Training Provider (registration valid to 3 August 2027), and several of its clinicians are HRD Corp Accredited Trainers. Engagement model: (1) Discovery, (2) Custom Proposal, (3) Delivery and Reporting. Target sectors include Government and GLCs, Financial Services, Technology, Higher Education, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and SMEs.

Business case: workplace stress costs Malaysian employers an estimated RM1.8 billion annually in lost productivity, yet fewer than 10% of companies have structured mental health programmes. Average return on wellness investment is about 4:1.

## Damaura (AI companion platform)

Damaura is Serenitilabs' AI companion for mental wellbeing: Southeast Asia's culturally intelligent AI companion, grounded in CBT, DBT and ACT. It works in English, BM or Manglish, with an optional faith layer (Universal or Islamic). Website: https://damaura.ai. Web app, free to start: https://damaura-app.netlify.app. Native apps for the App Store and Google Play are coming soon. Product contact: hello@damaura.ai.

- Today: a one-tap mood check-in, one gentle next step, a daily rhythm, and the days you showed up. No streaks to lose.
- Talk: chat in English, BM or Manglish, with breathing and grounding exercises inside the chat. Crisis lines appear when things sound heavy.
- Practice: Morning Intention, Mindful Moments, Mood Check-in, Gratitude, Evening Reflection, and a journal with a daily prompt.
- Journey: mood over time, the days you showed up, and themes from reflections. No scores.
- How replies work: every reply weighs safety, clinical psychology and culture; when things get heavier, specialist agents take a closer look.
- Safety is never paywalled. Damaura is an AI companion, not an emergency service. Crisis lines shown in the app: Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929, Talian Kasih 15999, MHPSS Helpline 03-2935 9935 (Ministry of Health), and 999.
- For organisations: employers see aggregate engagement and recurring themes, never anyone's conversations or reflections. A theme only appears once five or more people share it.

More: https://sereniti.my/damaura

- Sarah Aleesa Aguinaldo: Co-Founder and Clinical Director. Registered clinical psychologist; clinical services, training and capacity building, research.

## Team

### Sarah Aleesa Aguinaldo — Lead Therapist and Clinical Director
Licensed clinical psychologist with over 8 years of experience across clinical and non-clinical settings. Integrates cognitive-behavioural, person-centred, and mindfulness-based approaches, with expertise in anxiety disorders, depression, trauma recovery, and workplace burnout. Qualifications include a Master of Clinical Psychology and registration with the Malaysian Allied Health Professions Council.

### Ummu Nazra Nadzam — Registered Clinical Psychologist and HRD Corp Accredited Trainer
Works with trauma, ADHD, autism spectrum conditions, anxiety, mood disorders, and psycho-oncology across all age groups. Integrates Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), psychodynamic, and trauma-focused approaches. Registered Clinical Psychologist (MAHPC CP00227), HRD Corp Accredited Trainer (28008), and a National Paralympic Classifier.

## Clinical capabilities

Therapeutic approaches: Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), Psychodynamic Therapy, Trauma-Focused Therapy, Person-Centred and Mindfulness-Based approaches.

Areas of expertise: anxiety, depression and burnout; trauma and PTSD; ADHD and autism spectrum (ASD); children, adolescents and adults; psycho-oncology and grief; workplace mental health.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is Serenitilabs?
A: An AI-native mental health provider in Malaysia. Its licensed clinical psychologists deliver psychotherapy and corporate wellness programmes for individuals and organisations, and its own AI companion, Damaura, supports people between sessions.

Q: What services does Serenitilabs offer?
A: Psychotherapy for adults, children, couples, and families; corporate wellness programmes for organisations; and Damaura, an AI companion for support between sessions.

Q: Does Serenitilabs offer online therapy?
A: Yes. Therapy is available both online and in person, in English and Bahasa Malaysia.

Q: Where is Serenitilabs located?
A: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, serving clients across the country.

Q: What is Damaura?
A: Damaura is Serenitilabs' AI companion for mental wellbeing, built for Southeast Asia and grounded in CBT, DBT and ACT. It offers one-tap mood check-ins, small daily practices, a journal, and a chat in English, BM or Manglish, with an optional faith layer. It is free to start on the web at https://damaura.ai. It is an AI companion, not an emergency service.

Q: How do I start or book a session?
A: Contact the team at hello@sereniti.my or +60 18-398 1795, or use the contact form at https://sereniti.my/about/contact.
